descriptions.text: Bang Bro Cost: 5 Mana Target: Temporarily Enchant Equipped Item Duration: 5 minutes + 1 minute per level of spell. Requires 5 minute cooldown. Adds both fire and electrical damage to any currently-equipped item. May not be cast on flesh. Well, actually it can be cast on (your own) flesh, but I really wouldn't recommend it. May inflict Burn and Shock on targets. Can also be used to cook hotdogs and other items.

recap.text: Carl reads the tome from Miss Quill's bronze boss box. Bang Bro costs five mana, lasts five minutes plus one per level, adds fire and electrical damage to an equipped item, and cooks hotdogs. Mordecai says it works on the gauntlet, not the xistera. Carl casts it on the gauntlet and punches Gore-Gore in the kidney, and the health bar drops five percent.

Carl punches a skull that has come through the missing windshield into the cab mid-race, while sugar hermits surge in the gaps between the giant tubes. The skull explodes, but the purple thing that lived inside it stays attached to his metal fist and starts to slither, octopus-like, toward his arm. He casts Bang Bro, which electrifies the gauntlet, and the creature drops off, dead and sizzling.

beats.headline: Out of Quill's boss box
beats.text: Among the loot from the quest is the bronze boss box from killing Miss Quill, and inside it a magical tome for a spell called Bang Bro. Carl sets it aside, and after a new skill comes back to it: five mana, five minutes and a minute more per level, fire and electrical damage on any equipped item, and it cooks hotdogs. He shows Mordecai. It will work on the gauntlet, Mordecai says, but not on the xistera, not the way Carl loads it, and on his foot only while his invulnerable buff is up. It is a good spell in his mana price range. Carl reads the tome and adds the spell to his list.
beats.gist: Carl reads the Bang Bro tome from Quill's boss box and adds the spell to his list.

beats.headline: Lit up for Gore-Gore
beats.text: A smoke curtain, Donut's Hole in front of the charging mantaur, Carl's Fear, and then he casts Bang Bro on his gauntlet, which glows with electrical fire, and downs a mana refill. Gore-Gore swings blind through the smoke, squealing about treachery, magic and wizardry. Carl punches him in the kidney of his lower torso; the body feels like a sack stuffed with gravel, and the health bar drops maybe five percent. A notification hangs on his interface, 1.5, and he remembers to be careful: every punch from that gauntlet has a 1.5 percent chance to summon Grull.
beats.gist: Carl casts Bang Bro on his gauntlet and punches Gore-Gore, who barely flinches; each punch risks summoning Grull.

beats.headline: A skull on the fist
beats.text: Mid-race, sugar hermits surge in the gaps between the giant tubes, and a skull comes into the cab through the missing windshield. Carl punches it with his gauntlet and it explodes, but the purple thing living inside the skull is still attached to the metal fist, and it starts to slither, octopus-like, toward his arm. He casts Bang Bro, which electrifies the weapon. The creature drops off, dead, sizzling.
beats.gist: Carl punches a skull, and when the purple creature clings to his fist, Bang Bro electrifies it.
